quarterly_data.quarter: FuelCell Energy press release: FuelCell Energy Block System Receives 99.873% PJM Capacity (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FuelCell Energy's Block System received a 99.873% rating in PJM Interconnection's unit-specific Effective Load Carrying Capability (ELCC) assessment for the 2028/2029 period, meaning PJM may count nearly 99.9 MW of every 100 MW evaluated as dependable capacity; the company notes any future participation in PJM's Reliability Backstop Procurement would be subject to PJM's evaluation process.
